token.title: The admin token
token.intro: This console manages the instance on this machine. It asks for the token the instance wrote when it first started.
token.label: Admin token
token.missing: No token yet. The instance wrote one when it first started; it is in the store, next to the configuration.
token.hint: The token is kept in this browser's local storage. It is never sent anywhere but this instance.

error.title: The instance could not be reached
error.unauthorized: The instance refused the token. Paste the one it wrote when it first started.
error.notFound: The instance did not know that path.
error.network: The instance could not be reached. Is it still running, and is its admin listener bound?

overview.title: Overview
overview.noHealth: No route has backends that are probed.

routes.title: Routes
routes.none: No routes. Every host is answered 404.
routes.added: The route was added. A running instance picks it up on its next reload.
routes.removed: The route was removed. A running instance stops serving it on its next reload.

clients.title: Clients
clients.disabled: Two-factor is off. Every client below may connect without a second factor.
clients.publicKeyHint: The public half of an Ed25519 key pair, 64 hex characters. The device proves itself by signing each challenge.
clients.force: Replace the credential that is already there
clients.issued: The credential was issued. A running instance accepts it on its next reload.
